mike_s: Heads-up: observed flakey onboarding in sampleapp when using Retrofit suspend adapter + OkHttp Authenticator. On Android 13/14 it's fine, but Android 15 emulator shows occasional duplicate POSTs and an occasional crash 'request body is not repeatable' during token refresh. Repro attached.

anya_p: can you paste the minimal repro steps and key logs?

mike_s: repro: 1) start UploadActivity, 2) kick off multipart file upload, 3) server returns 401, 4) emulator toggle network (airplane mode) mid-refresh. Result: sometimes two POSTs after refresh; sometimes app crashes with IllegalStateException from OkHttp replay. Logs: 

```
2026-03-21T09:11:02.001Z mike_s DEBUG OkHttp --> POST /v1/upload
2026-03-21T09:11:02.220Z mike_s DEBUG OkHttp <-- 401 /v1/upload
2026-03-21T09:11:02.221Z mike_s DEBUG Auth Starting refresh
2026-03-21T09:11:02.450Z mike_s INFO Network airplane mode toggled
2026-03-21T09:11:02.780Z mike_s DEBUG OkHttp --> POST /v1/upload (replay)
2026-03-21T09:11:02.780Z mike_s DEBUG OkHttp --> POST /v1/upload (duplicate)
2026-03-21T09:11:02.781Z mike_s ERROR OkHttp java.lang.IllegalStateException: request body is not repeatable
```

mike_s: client uses `suspend fun` services, CallAdapter v2. Authenticator implemented as blocking refresh on OkHttp thread. OkHttp client has `retryOnConnectionFailure(true)` and default dispatcher.

sam_k: two related issues: 1) Non-repeatable streaming bodies (MultipartBody.Part backed by InputStream) will throw if OkHttp tries to replay. 2) Coroutine suspend adapter can re-create underlying Call if coroutine cancellation/resume semantics differ across dispatchers, which combined with Authenticator retries can produce multiple in-flight requests.

anya_p: what's the simplest mitigation we can ship in sampleapp and recommend in SDK docs?

mike_s: I prototyped two fixes: A) move refresh out of Authenticator into an Interceptor and implement single-flight refresh using an AtomicReference<CompletableDeferred<String>?> so concurrent requests wait on the same refresh; B) add a ReplayableRequestBody helper that caches stream to a temp file when size > threshold so OkHttp can replay safely. Patch notes below.

mike_s: ReplayableRequestBody sketch:

```
class ReplayableRequestBody(val source: InputStream, val threshold: Int = 256*1024): RequestBody() {
  private val cacheFile by lazy { File.createTempFile("rbuf", null) }
  override fun contentType() = MediaType.parse("application/octet-stream")
  override fun contentLength() = -1L
  override fun writeTo(sink: BufferedSink) {
    if (!cacheFile.exists()) {
      cacheFile.outputStream().use { out -> source.copyTo(out) }
    }
    cacheFile.inputStream().use { it.copyTo(sink.outputStream()) }
  }
}
```

mike_s: Interceptor single-flight sketch (pseudo):

```
val refreshRef = AtomicReference<CompletableDeferred<String>?>(null)
val token = getToken()
val req = chain.request().newBuilder().header("Authorization","Bearer $token").build()
val resp = chain.proceed(req)
if (resp.code == 401) {
  val d = refreshRef.get() ?: CompletableDeferred<String>().also { if (!refreshRef.compareAndSet(null, it)) it.cancel() }
  val newToken = runBlocking { d.await() } // or better suspend solution
  return chain.proceed(req.newBuilder().header("Authorization","Bearer $newToken").build())
}
return resp
```

anya_p: runBlocking in interceptor is ugly but pragmatic. Alternative is to provide a coroutine-aware CallAdapter helper in SDK so interceptor can suspend without blocking OkHttp threads. Also document that Authenticator should avoid blocking network calls and that streaming bodies are non-repeatable.

sam_k: agree. Short-term: sampleapp PR with ReplayableRequestBody (opt-in) + Interceptor single-flight example. Medium-term: add a TokenRefreshInterceptor in SDK that is suspend-friendly and a ReplayableRequestBody utility with disk-threshold config. Add docs: "Android SDK: beware Authenticator + streaming bodies + retryOnConnectionFailure interactions."

devex-bot: Created RED-DEVEX-3399: "SDK helper: TokenRefreshInterceptor + ReplayableRequestBody + docs" with reproducer and proposed PR. <https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-DEVEX-3399>

mike_s: I'll open PR with opt-in buffer option and a failing e2e e2e that toggles airplane mode during refresh. Will also add note to onboarding guide. Thanks all :thumbsup:

anya_p: thanks, please tag me on the PR for review.
